recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured composition featuring a central photographic window framed by a heavy, distressed black border. The background is a deep maroon with subtle damask patterns and vertical grunge textures. The central photo depicts three men in smart-casual attire against a backdrop of red damask wallpaper and ornate gold-leaf wall panels.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph is nested within a rounded-corner black frame that acts as a focal window.
The large display typography overlaps the top edge of the photo frame, creating depth.
The vertical textured strip on the left balances the horizontal weight of the top typography.
The deep maroon background color is echoed in the red wallpaper within the photograph.
coreInvariants: Heavy vignette and distressed outer borders
Combination of red damask and gold architectural details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned mid-ground within a central rectangular frame, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright white title, move down to the central portrait, and then to the vertical textured branding on the left margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins and dark maroon borders provide a claustrophobic, intimate framing effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and White (Wall panels and Typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value, high-saturation reds paired with high-value white text for maximum legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and thin)
Varying heights for the first and last letters of words
Subtle flared terminals resembling a modern serif/sans hybrid
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'S' have elongated tails or curves that extend vertically.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-condensed display type and ultra-wide tracked subtitle.
graphicDevices: Vertical distressed text watermark on left

preserve: Tall verticality of the main title
Wide letter spacing of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, slightly stylized feel of the display text.
Perfect for the clean, spaced-out subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark maroon background with a subtle red damask pattern. In the center, place a rectangular window with rounded corners showing three men in suits standing in a room with red wallpaper and ornate gold wall moldings. Apply a heavy black grunge border around the entire image and the central window.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, tall, white condensed sans-serif text at the top, overlapping the window. Below it, add a second line of text in a thin, widely-spaced sans-serif font. Add a vertical, low-opacity watermark of the subtitle text along the left edge.

verificationChecks: Is the top text tall and condensed?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked?
Does the central photo have a rounded black frame?
Is the background a textured deep maroon?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central photo frame
Specific pattern of the damask wallpaper
mustRedesign: Original artist names and specific album titles
Exact facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp typography against a messy background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is perfectly legible against the dark background.
Ensure the grunge texture does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the vertical text on the left is oriented correctly (bottom-to-top).
Confirm the rounded corners of the inner frame are consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ornate Interior Photography] + [Distressed Border Overlay] + [Ultra-Condensed Display Type] + [Wide-Tracked Subtitle] + [Maroon/Gold Palette].
